title: Important Update: ICAI Self-Paced Module Tests Suspended for Maintenance (Oct 11-20, 2026)
content:
# Important Update: ICAI Self-Paced Module Tests Suspended for Maintenance (Oct 11-20, 2026)

Ek important update hai. ICAI ne Self-Paced Module Tests (SPMT) ko temporarily suspend karne ka announce kiya hai for maintenance and upgradation.

Students, please note these key details:
*   **What:** Self-Paced Online Module Tests (SPMT) will not be conducted.
*   **When (Suspension Period):** From October 11, 2026, to October 20, 2026.
*   **Why:** For essential maintenance and software upgradation of the SPMT portal.
*   **Slot Booking Resumption:** Slot booking for SPMT will resume from October 21, 2026, onwards.
*   **Announcement Date:** This announcement was made by the Examination Department of ICAI on August 24, 2026.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/post.html?post_id=19803)

*Published on: 25 August 2026*
